name: cinlink
description: CinLink media tools for agents: subtitles, dubbing, video understanding/deconstruction, local media/editor export, AI generation, and hosted workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Create, understand, edit, and export video
interface.longDescription: Use CinLink from agents through focused skills and a hosted-first CLI. Configure a CinLink API key, transcribe and translate media, create dubbing, understand or deconstruct videos, replace visual references, export local media and editor handoffs, generate AI images/videos, and run hosted multi-step media workflows.
defaultPrompt: Transcribe this video and create subtitles
Deconstruct this video and replace its product
Export this video as a Final Cut project
